name: NWE Resources Group Berhad
overview: NWE Resources Group Berhad 于2026年在马来西亚交易所 ACE 市场完成首次公开募股（IPO），公开发行143,145,540股新股。公司业务线涵盖健康食品分销与配方供应、个人护理产品包装制造与分销以及餐饮产品供应，但除IPO相关公告外，今年公告中未披露各业务板块的具体扩张、缩减、合约或退出动态。
overview_en: NWE Resources Group Berhad completed its initial public offering (IPO) on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad in 2026, comprising a public issue of 143,145,540 new ordinary shares.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年完成首次公开募股并在 ACE 市场上市，公开发行143,145,540股新股。
segments.note_en: Completed its initial public offering and listing on the ACE Market this year, with a public issue of 143,145,540 new shares.

actions.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE LISTING OF NWE RESOURCES GROUP BERHAD ("NWE RESOURCES" OR "COMPANY") ON THE ACE MARKET OF BU

actions.text_en: Completed the initial public offering, publicly issuing 143,145,540 new shares and listing on the ACE Market.
